William F. Cody, The Life of Buffalo Bill.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-f-cody/the-life-of-buffalo-bill

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William F. Cody, the author, the annotator, died 1917.
- Frank E. Bliss, the writer of the introduction, death year not in the facts file. Not needed: the text was first published in the United States (see the country paragraph).

First publication of the text used: 1879 (SE colophon: 'The Life of Buffalo Bill was published in 1879 by William F. Cody.'; the Wikipedia citation gives the 1879 edition as printed in Hartford, Connecticut)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1879 in Hartford, Connecticut, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below). A work published in 1879 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 1975.
- Country of origin: the United States. The first publication was in the United States, before 1931, so the United States rule settles the country of origin whatever the death year. The writer of the introduction, Frank E. Bliss, has no death year in the facts file, and this does not change the result because the text was first published in the United States.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: The Life of Buffalo Bill was published in 1879 by William F. Cody.
- Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buffalo_Bill: citation 'Cody, William F. (1879). The Life of Hon. William F. Cody Known as Buffalo Bill the Famous Hunter, Scout, and Guide: An Autobiography. Hartford'
